# King Art D. Pacumberto — Portfolio

> Official portfolio of King Art D. Pacumberto, a BSIT student at the Polytechnic University of the Philippines — Quezon City. The portfolio documents software, data, embedded, IT support, technical production, student leadership, and creative photography work.

Use the linked Markdown references for concise, factual summaries. Project status and scope are stated explicitly; proposed or synthetic-data demonstrations are not described as live production systems.

- [Experience and education](https://legioniz.github.io/experience.md): supplied roles, dates, responsibilities, education, and selected recognition.
